_why: The preregistration appendix used to open with 'Every experiment in this paper was declared
in a frozen JSON file committed and pushed before the code that produced it existed.' That
sentence was false: seven of the seventeen artifacts the manuscript reads have no declaration.
It is the same defect caught earlier in R1 -- a claim about process that nobody checked.
This file is the classification the appendix now states, and audit_manuscript.py enforces it:
every artifact a generator reads must appear here exactly once, everything under
'preregistered' must really have a frozen declaration, and nothing in the other three classes
may quietly have one. A number in the manuscript can now be traced to how it was licensed.

preregistered._rule: a declaration frozen, committed and pushed before the code that produced it existed

survey._rule: establishes design-side facts BEFORE a declaration can be written, and estimates nothing
survey.m27_corpus_survey_all.json: counts what each RMDB deposit contains so the second-corpus experiment could be declared at all; no effect is computed and none may be
survey.m33_cluster_census.json: counts what the cluster bootstrap resamples -- puzzles, design cells and their balance -- so the intervals can be read; no effect is estimated
survey.m34_admission_census.json: the admission ledger from both implementations of the criterion, so the counts the manuscript prints are read rather than typed; estimates nothing

review._rule: written after the run it checks, because the run needed checking; cannot be preregistered without preregistering its own conclusion
review.m26r3_realistic_calibration.json: recalibrates retention at the separation this corpus actually has, after m26r2 was found to calibrate in a regime the data never visits
review.m26v_alpha_verify.json: recomputes the headline with a second, independently written estimator
review.m26w_rescue_provenance.json: reproduces the outcome column from raw reactivity, to show it contains no model
review.m28r_review.json: reviews M28's two boundary results before either is written down
review.m31r_review.json: reviews M31 before its verdict is read, and supplies the interval K2 was written without
review.m32r_review.json: re-checks M32's dynamic range and its 1e-4 censoring floor, neither of which M32's own declaration contained
review.m26r4_calibration_symmetry.json: re-reads M26r3's committed sweep after the manuscript audit found one arm's correlation reported and the other arm's omitted inside the same retraction; shows both correlations are produced by a single sweep point and supplies the span the retraction now rests on

support._rule: a supporting or display quantity for a claim already made elsewhere; states no new claim
support.m31s_depth_share.json: the within-cell rank agreement between each predictor and depth itself, which M31 and M31r both need and neither reports
support.m31t_recovery_curve.json: the recovery-versus-budget curve behind Claim 3's figure, so the figure is drawn from a committed artifact
support.m37_channel_ledger.json: the channel ledger of Section 5.8: it collects prices already published in the sections named beside them, cross-checks each against the macro this manuscript prints, closes the one identity among them and names the choosers it cannot price. It estimates nothing.
support.m36_readout_scale_declaration.json: read so the preregistration table quotes the staked thresholds from the frozen declaration rather than having them retyped beside the measured values; not a result

declaration._rule: a frozen declaration read directly by the generator, so a staked threshold printed in the manuscript is quoted from the declaration and never retyped
